findings.reason: §6 already solves this exact shape by re-deriving the stall clock each tick (`recovery_watch._stall_reading`); §10 must say the station re-reads the settle clock each tick rather than only on change, or the node implements an event trigger that cannot expire.
findings.text: "The station runs both once per change" cannot satisfy §10's own done-when "a run resumed by advice is not reviewed until its settle window has passed": the window expires on the clock (`REVIEW_SETTLE_SECONDS` measured from a resume stamp, reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1258-1271), and a resumed worker that writes nothing produces no change at the instant the window passes, so a purely change-driven station never fires the review

findings.reason: the node's done-when ("a run resumed by advice is not reviewed until its settle window has passed") fails against today's code and §10 names no mechanism to make it pass; one clause naming `_latest_resume_at` (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:205, which already reads both stamps) as what the settle helper must switch to would make the node's work unambiguous.
findings.text: §10 asserts in the present tense that "A run resumed by a coordinator's `crew resume --advice` starts the same settle window an automatic resume does", but the settle reader takes only the sweep's own stamp (`resume = record.get("auto_resume")`, reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1266) while the advice door records `resume_superseded_head` and withdraws any queued review (reckon/crew/resumption.py:1302, :1489) without stamping `auto_resume`, so today an advice resume restarts review immediately

findings.reason: §8's own text already names the mutant (`a settle-aware subscriber still lists the live directory each second until §10 moves settle detection into the station`, plan.html:266-267), so one clause "a subscriber that keeps the per-second live-directory scan must fail the trace measure" makes the new measure falsifiable at no design cost.
findings.text: the settle-aware trace measure is the only measure of the settle-aware subscriber's reads, and §10 declares no control that fails it; a trace naming nothing could equally be a subscriber that was not running or a `strace` that attached to nothing
